subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Pollution ___________ ecosystems and wildlife.
solution:
The correct answer is '**damages**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb "**damages**" is the correct form of the verb to agree with the singular subject "**pollution**."
 
• Pollution refers to a singular noun, so the verb must be in the singular form ("**damages**").</
